context.title: feat(shell): add volume slider to quick settings
context.body:
## Summary
Adds a volume slider to quick settings.

## Type
feat

## Linked owning issue
Closes #42

## Duplicate-scope check
Searched shell issues and PRs for "volume slider"; #41 covers output switching, not the slider. No duplicate scope.

## Declared capabilities
None — uses the existing audio service already declared by the shell.

## Validation
Ran `npm test` in shell repo; manual VM check.

## QA status
Ran: `npm test` (passed); manual VM check of the slider.
Pending: HiDPI and multi-monitor scenarios from the qa Premium Acceptance Matrix.

## Tooltip & accessibility
Slider has an accessible name and keyboard control; tooltip "Volume" verified with keyboard-only use.

## Translation impact
One new tooltip string, added through the existing translation catalog.

## Security notes
None — no new privileges, network, or file access.

## Performance impact
N/A — renders on demand with the existing quick-settings panel; no polling or always-on cost.

## Risks
Low; UI-only change.
